connections.title: Waterfall-shaped REST subset (x-api-key header, JSON bodies)
connections.instructions: Point a raw-HTTP client's base URL at WATERFALL_API_URL and send WATERFALL_API_KEY in the x-api-key header. Routes mirror /v1/enrichment/{contact,phone,company}, /v1/search/{contact,company}, /v1/job/change, /v1/verify/email, /v2/account and /v1/api-keys; the calling Waterfall key is the actor attribute waterfallApiKey (fallback: the seeded master key), not the token. Compatibility with any client is not verified.
